description: Paid data access. Returns no records itself: it builds the HTTPS query URL for your filters and returns the x402 payment terms (USDC on Base; amsterdam-events $0.005, security-advisories $0.003, vulnerability-watch $0.003, eu-tenders $0.01, uk-tenders $0.005, au-contracts $0.005, eu-funding $0.005, us-grants $0.005, cert-advisories $0.003, eu-medicines $0.005, sanctions-entities $0.005, product-recalls $0.005, eu-legislation $0.005, us-federal-register $0.005, drug-shortages $0.005, public-holidays $0.002, travel-advisories $0.003, vat-rates $0.002, company-identifiers $0.003, hazard-alerts $0.002, sec-filings $0.003 per call). Send a GET to http_endpoint with an x402 client (v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or v1 X-PAYMENT header) to receive up to 100 matching records; no account or API key. Filters per dataset: amsterdam-events: from, to, district, q, min_visitors, limit, offset; security-advisories: cve, vendor, product, q, added_since, ransomware, min_epss, limit, offset; vulnerability-watch: cve, vendor, product, q, min_cvss, kev, updated_since, limit, offset; eu-tenders: country, cpv, q, deadline_after, deadline_before, published_since, min_value, nature, limit, offset; uk-tenders: nation, region, cpv, q, buyer, deadline_after, deadline_before, published_since, min_value, category, sme, status, source, limit, offset; au-contracts: segment, q, code, buyer, supplier, abn, min_value, max_value, method, published_since, published_before, active_on, limit, offset; eu-funding: q, programme, status, type, deadline_after, deadline_before, min_budget, limit, offset; us-grants: q, agency, category, eligibility, instrument, status, closing_after, closing_before, posted_since, min_award, limit, offset; cert-advisories: cve, vendor, product, q, cert, country, type, updated_since, kev, limit, offset; eu-medicines: q, type, category, substance, atc, area, holder, status, flag, shortage, updated_since, limit, offset; sanctions-entities: q, list, type, programme, country, identifier, updated_since, limit, offset; product-recalls: q, country, authority, source, category, classification, firm, allergen, status, product_code, origin, since, limit, offset; eu-legislation: type, author, subject, q, celex, amends, published_since, in_force, limit, offset; us-federal-register: type, agency, q, published_since, effective_after, comments_close_after, cfr_title, cfr_part, significant, limit, offset; drug-shortages: q, substance, country, status, since, source, holder, area, limit, offset; public-holidays: country, region, date_from, date_to, year, type, q, limit, offset; travel-advisories: destination, issuer, min_level, any_region, changed_since, q, limit, offset; vat-rates: country, region, type, cn, q, on_date, limit, offset; company-identifiers: lei, q, country, status, change, since, limit, offset; hazard-alerts: type, country, min_level, since, near, source, open, min_magnitude, q, limit, offset; sec-filings: form, group, cik, ticker, q, since, limit, offset. For free records without filters use get_sample.

dataset.description: Dataset id. amsterdam-events: Amsterdam events; security-advisories: Security advisories; vulnerability-watch: Vulnerability watch; eu-tenders: EU public tenders; uk-tenders: UK public tenders; au-contracts: Australian Government awarded contracts; eu-funding: EU funding calls and grants; us-grants: US federal grant opportunities; cert-advisories: European CERT security advisories; eu-medicines: EU medicines: authorisations, shortages, safety communications and referrals (EMA); sanctions-entities: Sanctioned entities, vessels and aircraft (EU, OFAC, UK and Canada lists); product-recalls: Product recalls and safety alerts (US FDA, US CPSC, US NHTSA, Health Canada, Transport Canada, CFIA, UK FSA, UK OPSS, EU Safety Gate, EU RASFF); eu-legislation: EU legislation: new and amended acts in the Official Journal (regulations, directives, decisions); us-federal-register: US Federal Register: final rules, proposed rules, notices and presidential documents; drug-shortages: Medicine shortages (US FDA, EMA, Spain AEMPS, France ANSM); public-holidays: Public and bank holidays (official government lists, current and next year); travel-advisories: Travel advisories (official travel advice levels per destination from the US, UK, Canada and the Netherlands); vat-rates: VAT and GST rates per country, region and category (official, current and historical); company-identifiers: Legal Entity Identifiers (LEI): new and closed legal entities worldwide (GLEIF, last 31 days); hazard-alerts: Natural hazard events worldwide (USGS earthquakes, NASA EONET, Copernicus EMS); sec-filings: US SEC EDGAR filings by companies (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, S-1, 13D/G, Form D and more), last 30 days.

filters.description: Optional filters as name to string value, for example {"country":"NLD","cpv":"72","limit":"5"}. Allowed names per dataset are listed in this description and in list_datasets.

name: query_dataset

http_endpoint.description: GET this URL with an x402 payment to receive the records.

payment_required.description: Always true: the endpoint needs an x402 payment.

x402.description: x402 v1 payment requirements (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo); v2 terms come in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header of the endpoint.

title: Get the paid query URL and x402 terms
